column1: # Catalog draft, 2026-11-26: the English words of the catalog (job 470, languages.ts), drafted by Claude.
# Machine review: catalog/REVIEW-en.md (Claude Opus) filled the review cells; a person still reviews every row in the PR (catalog/REVIEW.md, Legal N-215).
# Inputs: only the repo's catalog TSVs (dictionary.tsv, synonyms.tsv, dictionary.en.tsv) and general
# knowledge. No user data, no Open Food Facts, no Wikipedia. No allergen, nutrition or health facts;
# no medicines or supplements (no plasters, painkillers, vitamins, tests). No brands.
# Columns: word as an English list writes it (plural for countables, singular for mass nouns and
# one-off items); concept is the dictionary.tsv term it joins (empty: a concept of its own); forms
# are irregular or extra plurals, US/UK spelling variants and real misspellings. The generator adds
# the singular of a plural word itself (englishInflections), so a singular word lists its plural.
# Order: high, then medium confidence; within each, by aisle.
# Probe (supabase/classifier/probe_drafts.sh, local stack, all rows): no broken rows; dips and
# smoothies are listed (German terms already). No dictionary term, synonym, wordlist, sweep or
# expected.en.tsv text changes aisle. Changed aisles are all English compounds of probe_compounds.txt.
# Wrong ones kept, because the head word is far more common than the compound:
#   oil: bike oil, motor oil, oil cloth -> pantry; fruit: fruit bowl, fruit fly trap, fruit knife -> produce;
#   mint: peppermint -> produce; fennel: fennel seeds -> produce; pumpkin: pumpkin pie -> produce;
#   red peppers: red pepper paste -> produce; peas: mangetout peas, pea protein -> frozen;
#   soup: soup bowls -> pantry; nutmeg: nutmeg grinder -> pantry; cake: candles for cake -> bakery;
#   biscuits: biscuit mix -> sweets; fries: fries seasoning -> frozen; iced tea: iced tea powder -> drinks;
#   figs: dried figs -> produce; sorbet: Sorbetschale -> frozen (as Weinglas -> drinks on main).
# Rows added only to keep a compound right: air conditioner, breath mints, fish cakes, mince pies,
# mincemeat, split peas, mushy peas, sourdough starter, matcha (Matcha Latte), roasted red peppers,
# meatloaf; chili flakes carries red pepper flakes and crushed red pepper.
# Left out on purpose: champagne (its row breaks the fuzzy match of wordlist.tsv's "Champions"
# typo; Champagne already reaches drinks by fuzzy match), jelly as dessert, UK chips (fries),
# sprouts, squash, tap, dummy, plasters, duck, corn, peppers, mints.
# expected.en.tsv rows no word row can fix: paprika (a German produce term: an English row must
# name it as concept, so it stays produce), tooth paste and toiletpaper (split or joined spelling).
